component.name: Switchboard
component.summary: Switch GPU modes and keep your dGPU asleep

description.p: A small companion app for cardwire. Switchboard talks to the cardwired service over D-Bus to switch GPU modes, show what is waking your discrete GPU, and keep it in its lowest power state.

ul.li: Switch between Integrated, Hybrid and Smart modes
Per-GPU status: driver, live power state and a block toggle
A live feed of the processes cardwire blocked
A tray icon showing the current mode at a glance
